home.label: HOME · LOCAL QUEST
home.controlPlane: authenticated local Stephanos route to the Battle Bridge
home.airLinkRole: optional separate PCVR or high-fidelity media mode, not the bridge entry requirement

caravan.label: CARAVAN · REMOTE STARLINK

authorityRules: The Quest shell never owns canonical mission state.
Offline mode is read-only and cannot cache approval authority.
A reconnect never repeats or infers approval.
The control plane remains separate from optional media streaming.
Identity, target revision, freshness, risk and expiry must be verified before any future approval path is enabled.
currentLimitations: Current renderer is a flat source prototype embedded by the Quest entry shell.
Immersive WebXR rendering is not yet implemented or observed.
The PWA has not been packaged, signed, uploaded or installed on Quest.
Digital Asset Link values cannot be finalized until a signing key fingerprint exists.
No live Stephanos control-plane endpoint is connected.

firstCodexTasks: Run deterministic source tests at the exact PR head.
Serve the app from a trusted HTTPS origin.
Implement or integrate the first immersive WebXR captain scene.
Package with Meta forked Bubblewrap using immersive mode.
Create and preserve the signing keystore.
Generate the exact Digital Asset Link statement.
Upload to the private ALPHA release channel and invite Stephan's Meta account.
Prove that the app appears in Quest Library and launches from its icon.
Prove home LAN and caravan Starlink control-plane profiles separately.

mergeGate: Do not describe the package as a Quest VR app until exact-head tests, immersive WebXR proof, signed packaging, Digital Asset Link verification, ALPHA-channel installation and on-headset launch evidence are complete.
